entities.name: UniProt A4J3P2
observations: Reviewed glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase from Desulforamulus reducens; supplied 200-aa sequence is an exact full-length sequence match.
EC 2.3.1.275; transfers an acyl group from acyl-phosphate to sn-glycerol 3-phosphate, forming 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate (lysophosphatidic acid) and phosphate.
Annotated as a multipass cell-membrane protein involved in lipid/phospholipid metabolism; annotation specifies acyl-phosphate donor, not acyl-CoA or acyl-ACP.

entities.name: RHEA:34075
observations: acyl phosphate + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate → 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + phosphate; reaction mapped to EC 2.3.1.275.
